title: Vegito Is Dragon Ball’s Strongest Fusion for One Main Reason
content: Fusion flipped the Dragon Ball Z universe on its head when it was introduced in the Buu Saga. It didn’t follow simple math equations to get a specific power level , and revealed that it multiples the power of two fighters far beyond just doubling.
author: ComicBook

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Tales of Iga Manga Ends
content: Kodansha 's YanMaga Web platform published the final chapter of reguje 's Assassin’s Creed Shadows: Tales of Iga prequel manga for Ubisoft 's Assassin's Creed Shadows game on October 8.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Producers Confirm More of Korra & Asami’s Future in Season 2
content: Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ final episodes have dropped some major teases about Korra and Asami’s future together after the events of The Legend of Korra , and the producers of it all have confirmed that even more of that backstory will be revealed in the coming season and beyond.
author: ComicBook

title: SaGa Game Series' Localization Director Neil Broadley Dies
content: In a message written ahead of his death, Broadley stated that his work colleague would post this from him on his behalf should he die. He stated that he had been struggling with cancer and repeated complications from surgeries, chemotherapies, and radiation treatment.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia Is Getting Its Most Surprising Debut Yet With Cartoon Network
content: My Hero Academia is gearing up for one of its most surprising debuts yet as it’s set to start its broadcast with Cartoon Network Japan, and that’s likely going to be a wild home for it going forward.
author: ComicBook

title: K Manga Adds nyalra's Strayboy Overkill Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Sunday that it has added the Strayboy Overkill manga from Needy Girl Overdose (known as Needy Streamer Overload in English on Steam ) writer nyalra as a simpub. The manga centers on Hinako, a government worker who works for social services.
author: ANN

title: The Powerpuff Girls Creator Reveals Reboot Pitch Was Rejected Ahead of New Movie Revival
content: The creator behind the massively popular The Powerpuff Girls franchise has revealed that his take on a reboot has fallen through despite a new movie revival now being in the works with Warner Bros. Animation.

title: Deadline: Noah Of The Blood Sea Manga Gets Hollywood Live-Action Film Adaptation
content: Tyrus Pictures' Michael Zelman and Hamid Mokhneche are producing. The studio is optioning the film adaptation rights from Takeshobo . In addition, Deadline reported that the original manga is getting an English release in North America. The manga is also getting a release in Taiwan.
author: ANN
